rationale: No evidence-supported optimization can be safely applied to this workflow without risking coverage or behavior changes. The workflow already uses dependency caching (cache: 'pnpm' in setup-node), stale-run cancellation (concurrency with cancel-in-progress for non-main branches), and an explicit job timeout on the test job (timeout-minutes: 10). P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (fail-fast: true on the Node 20/22 matrix) is contraindicated because both matrix outcomes are required for cross-version compatibility diagnostics, and cancelling the Node 22 job when Node 20 fails would also suppress the release step that depends on Node 22 completing. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE does not apply because an equivalent pnpm cache already exists. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks representative timing data for the integrity job (which has no timeout), and imposing an unmeasured limit risks failing valid slow runs. Test/build selection patterns are contraindicated because the full test set and all required checks must run on each revision. No Bazel build exists to tune, and there are no scheduled workflows to pause or suppress.
